g.title: RK0Dependencies
g.text: A → B: A has an undefined symbol supplied by B. Hover an arrow to inspect its symbols.
Solid: default features with debug checks. Dashed: added by dynamic tasks, dynamic objects, or tracing.
Core pairs: core/src/name.c + core/inc/name.h. Headers are associations; edges describe compiled objects.
